name: PAMT CORP
summary: Pamt Corp. operates as a leading provider of truckload transportation and logistics services, primarily through its subsidiaries, serving clients across the United States, Mexico, and Canada. The company functions as a dry van truckload carrier, specializing in the conveyance of a wide array of goods. This includes crucial automotive components, time-sensitive expedited freight, diverse consumer products like general retail store inventory, and manufactured items such as heating and air conditioning units. Beyond core hauling, Pamt also extends its expertise through dedicated brokerage and logistics solutions. As of December 31, 2023, its substantial fleet consisted of 2,200 trucks, 300 of which were operated by independent contractors, complemented by 8,567 trailers. Founded in 1980, the company, originally known as P.A.M. Transportation Services, Inc., rebranded to Pamt Corp. in November 2024. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Tontitown, Arkansas.
